nodes.name: Material Verification (Before Installation)
nodes.description: Check the packaging bags. Ensure the brand and "R-Value" number look correct and match your plan. The material must be dry, not wet or moldy. Tip: Take a close-up photo of the label showing the "R-Value" (e.g., R2.0 or R4.0). This proves you used the correct product.

nodes.name: Coverage Completeness (Walls)
nodes.description: Stand in the center and look around. Ensure insulation fills every space in the wall frame from top to bottom. Check for empty spots in corners, around windows, and behind wires or pipes. Tip: Insulation is like a thermal jacket for your house. Any small gap lets heat escape, so check those tricky little corners!

nodes.name: Fit & Fluffiness (Installation Quality, Walls)
nodes.description: The material should look fluffy and hold itself up in the frame. It must not be sliding down (sagging) or squashed too tightly into small spaces. Tip: Insulation needs air to work. If it is squashed flat (compressed), it won't keep the house warm. It should be neat and fluffy, not wrinkled.

nodes.name: Coverage Completeness (Ceiling)
nodes.description: Look up at the ceiling structure. Ensure the insulation covers the entire area flatly. There should be no large gaps between the pieces. Tip: It should look like a continuous blanket covering the roof space. Double-check that the corners and edges are not left empty.
